name: Drayton RV Park
note: Drayton Park Board RV park on the north edge of town, behind the laundromat on ND 66 and west of the railroad tracks: back-in sites on grass around a gravel loop. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: City of Drayton Park Facilities page (draytonnd.com/park-facilities, read 2026-11-12): 'RV Park ... 20 Full-Hookup sites, Electricity, Sewer, Water, Wi-Fi, Fire rings, Picnic Tables', 'located on the north edge of Drayton, behind the laundromat ... southwest of the intersection of Hwy 66 and Hwy 44 on the west side of the railroad tracks', '2026 Rates: Nightly: $35.00, Weekly: $175.00, Monthly: $400.00', contact 701-520-1926, map pin C 'Drayton RV Park, 16043 ND-66' at 48.570566,-97.180123; city sheet 2024_Drayton_Campgrounds.pdf (draytonnd.com/documents/543): 'Drayton RV Park - (20 units) ... behind the Carwash/laundromat. Has Water/Sewer hookups, 30 and 50 AMP. No restrooms or showers', '**Owned and operated by the Drayton Park Board**'; ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (updated 07.17.2025) row 97: DRAYTON RV CAMPGROUND, Hwy 66, owner DRAYTON PARK DISTRICT, 20 lots -> a park-district RV park selling single nights (local: no price gate or presence rule). Separate from 6049 Schumacher Park (0.49 km SSW): own section and contact on the city page, own HHS licence (row 98 DRAYTON SCHUMACHER PARK, Wallace Avenue), in-town park vs this lot on ND 66 behind the laundromat. Also not Wilderness Drive Campground (lead 11; 250 Wilderness Dr, ~0.9 km N on ND 44, HHS row 425, 70 lots). Esri imagery 2026-11-12 (z19 at 48.57005,-97.18000): a gravel perimeter loop with ~20 back-in spots on grass facing a center row of utility posts; 10 rigs present, mostly 30-40-ft travel trailers and fifth wheels, with ~15-20 m from loop to the posts -> a 23-ft rig fits. No horse facilities, no road warning. Long-stay test 4: no nightly/monthly split is published anywhere (city page, 2024 sheet, HHS) -> passes on 'no count'; the city sends Sep-Oct public campers from Wilderness Drive (closed then for sugarbeet workers) to 'one of our other campgrounds', i.e. this park and Schumacher keep taking the public in harvest season.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery (800 m frame at 48.570566,-97.180123; 3.2 km frame at 48.5695,-97.170; z19 at 48.57005,-97.18000): the park sits in the light-industrial strip on the north edge of Drayton between ND 66 and the railroad; the nearest water is the Red River, ~0.7 km to the south-east beyond the town's streets and riverside woods, with no line of sight from the loop (only an industrial pond ~400 m north behind buildings and a golf-course pond to the south). No site is near any water -> not waterfront.
fees_source: https://draytonnd.com/park-facilities ('RV Park ... 2026 Rates: Nightly: $35.00 Weekly: $175.00 Monthly: $400.00 U.S. Funds only'), read 2026-11-12
hookups_source: https://draytonnd.com/park-facilities ('20 Full-Hookup sites', 'Electricity', 'Sewer', 'Water') and https://draytonnd.com/documents/543/2024_Drayton_Campgrounds.pdf ('Has Water/Sewer hookups, 30 and 50 AMP'), read 2026-11-12
sites_source: https://draytonnd.com/park-facilities ('20 Full-Hookup sites'); 2024_Drayton_Campgrounds.pdf ('Drayton RV Park - (20 units)'); ND HHS licensed list 07.17.2025 (20 lots), read 2026-11-12
facilities_source: https://draytonnd.com/documents/543/2024_Drayton_Campgrounds.pdf ('No restrooms or showers.') and https://draytonnd.com/park-facilities (lists 'Wi-Fi'; no restrooms or showers among the RV Park's amenities, though it lists them for the other two campgrounds), read 2026-11-12
flags: Long-stay: the park sells weekly ($175) and monthly ($400) stays, and the summer Esri imagery shows 10 of ~20 spots holding big travel trailers/fifth wheels that look parked for the season; Drayton's sugar-beet factory brings in harvest crews. No published count of nightly vs monthly sites exists, so test 4 passes on 'no count' with no caveat; AWH may want the long-term caveat on judgement.
Booking: the city page publishes no reservation method and no season for the RV Park, only a contact phone; booking and season groups are left unwritten.

No RV Life or Google listing of its own: RV Life's 'Drayton RV Campground' (254023) and Campendium's 'Drayton RV Park' both sit at 250 Wilderness Dr (Wilderness Drive Campground, lead 11), and Google's 'Drayton RV Park' search lands on Wilderness Drive (4.0/31). Not needed for a park-district campground.
Pin moved ~50 m S from the city's map pin (on the laundromat lot) to the centre of the site loop.
curation_note: ND lead 10 (2026-11-12): separate from 6049 Schumacher Park (0.49 km; own city-page section, own HHS licence DRAYTON RV CAMPGROUND vs DRAYTON SCHUMACHER PARK) and from Wilderness Drive Campground (~0.9 km N, lead 11). Third-party listings (RV Life 254023, Campendium) put the name 'Drayton RV Park/Campground' on the Wilderness Drive site; the city's own page is followed. Long-stay test 4: weekly/monthly rates published, no nightly share published anywhere -> passes on no count.
